body: Central scheduling rule from Legal::Fable (TermAl mailbox 6aeb8f5c #58, 2026-11-20 16:02Z), applied by Opus2. When Legal books a Central window for rincon-common Cargo, treat the window's STATED END as the release if no 'slot ... ended' notice has arrived by then; Legal still sends the notice. Reason: the V7-A-06 notice (window 10:00Z to 10:50Z; machine actually released at 10:15:36Z) reached Opus2 only at 16:02Z, so the hold, and the Engram 808a R35 Central queue behind it, lasted about 5.75 hours longer than needed. This is not a polling licence: the waker is the window's stated end time, taken at the next wake event after it, or the notice, whichever comes first.
